description.value:
Grown from tissue that died mid-transition and never finished. +2 apex item bonus to Reflex saves. Once per day, 1 action: become partially incorporeal for 1 minute — resistance 10 to physical damage, and move through solid objects up to 5 feet thick as difficult terrain.

Rider: Half-dead things notice half-dead tissue. Undead and unquiet spirits treat you as kin at first glance, and some of them don't correct the mistake quietly.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day 1-minute partial-incorporeality (Resistance 10 physical plus moving through solid objects as difficult terrain) is a limited-use activated ability -- needs a granted Action item plus a linked effect, same class of gap as every other timed activated buff in this pass. 'Undead notice you as kin' is a narrative trigger, not a mechanical one. The Reflex bonus above is real: unlike the raw-ability-score apex clauses elsewhere in this pass, a save bonus is a standard FlatModifier target with direct precedent throughout pf2e (item bonus type matches the card's own 'apex item bonus' wording).
